subject: MAP, custody & short-term escrow plan for eval materials
messages:
From: Marina Lopez <m.lopez@novatech.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: eval-team@novatech.com
Date: 2026-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation materials exchange — scope & acceptance gates

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Novatech is ready to move from POC to a scoped evaluation. We want to share a set of prompt packs, a ~4k test-case manifest, and a small seed dataset (~1.2GB compressed) for offline acceptance testing. Before we transfer files we need a short MAP that captures milestones, custody model, and the acceptance gates so Product and Security can sign off.

High level asks from our side:
- Short-term custody (ephemeral sandbox / lockbox) with automated takedown after acceptance (30 days preferred, can consider shorter).
- No redistribution or reuse outside the evaluation (explicit usage constraints).
- Audit log of downloads/queries and per-token billing visibility.
- Acceptance criteria: 80% top-1 accuracy on the labeled subset (we can share a small gold set) and no PII leakage above threshold.
- A one-page IP/derivative clause (we retain dataset ownership; model outputs are evaluated but should not be used to train external models).

Can you propose a minimal MAP and timeline? We need to sign off by the 28th to meet internal schedules. I can attach the manifest and a quick access checklist once we agree on custody model.

Marina
Marina Lopez
Head of Evaluation Programs | Novatech

Attachments: (manifest stub) testcases_manifest.csv
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Marina Lopez <m.lopez@novatech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation materials exchange — scope & acceptance gates

Marina —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can support an ephemeral lockbox and provide the audit/tracing you requested. I attached a short draft MAP (novatech_map_draft_v1.pdf) and an access checklist (access_instructions.md) so you can validate operational items. Proposed timeline (high-level):

- 7/15: Sign MAP (DocuSign) + mutual NDA note
- 7/16–7/17: Novatech uploads artifacts to our managed lockbox (encrypted at rest)
- 7/18: Redwood provisions ephemeral sandbox and provides credentials; limited to 5 se seats by default
- 7/18–7/25: Acceptance window (run tests, share runbook/metrics)
- 7/26: Final acceptance decision / takedown scheduled for 7/30 unless extended

Usage constraints we propose to capture in the MAP: retention window (default 14 days unless customer requests 30), no re-sharing, no external training use, and explicit destruction confirmation after takedown. We can make those fields editable in the MAP if you need shorter/longer retention.

Ben (cc) will help with the technical checklist and coordinate the lockbox upload. If 7/28 sign-off is your hard deadline we should get the DocuSign out today.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: novatech_map_draft_v1.pdf; access_instructions.md
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-07-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: lockbox & acceptance-test recommendations

Lauren / Priyom —

Quick internal recap after reviewing Marina's manifest:
- Storage: recommend managed lockbox (S3-backed, customer-supplied manifest) encrypted with Redwood KMS keys scoped to the MAP. We can provide an HSM-backed option if they insist.
- Retention: ops-friendly default of 14 days; if Novatech requires 30 days we can support but will flag for review (audit + cost).
- Access: role-based credentials, IP allowlist, and time-limited credentials for their test engineers.
- Audit: we will capture per-request token counts, user identity, timestamp, and query fingerprint; logs retained for 90 days by default and available for export.
- Acceptance tests: propose three checks — functional (top-1 >= 80% on gold set), safety (no PII leakage > 0.1% on sampled outputs), and perf (95th percentile latency below 600ms on 8k tokens/day profile).

Priyom — security sign-off items: do we need a SOC excerpt? Also should we lock down the sandbox VPC by default? My recommendation: sandbox in our shared tenancy but in an isolated VPC with audit hooks; escalate to private deployment only if they require CIS/HSM-level separation.

If we confirm these points I’ll update the MAP with the technical appendix and push DocuSign.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final MAP & transfer window — Novatech evaluation (NOVA-2026-EVAL-321)

Marina / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review we’ve finalized the MAP and operational steps. Summary below and links to the deliverables:

Key points (executive summary)
- Lockbox model: Redwood-managed encrypted lockbox with KMS. Files ingested by Novatech into a pre-authorized bucket.
- Retention: agreed 14-day default retention; Novatech may request 30-day retention (we have a one-click extension in MAP; note that cost/margin changes apply).
- Usage constraints: no redistribution, no model training on raw dataset, no derivative dataset publication. Outputs of tests may be shared in aggregate for evaluation purposes only.
- Acceptance window: 7/18–7/25. Final acceptance decision due 7/26; automatic takedown scheduled 7/30 at 23:59 PT if no extension is executed.
- Acceptance criteria: top-1 >= 80% on gold set supplied by Novatech; safety check for PII leakage below 0.1% on sampled outputs.
- Audit & logs: per-request token counts, user IDs, and access logs available; will provide a CSV export on request.

Operational links and attachments:
- MAP (final): https://app.redwood.ai/docu/NOVA-2026-EVAL-321
- Ephemeral sandbox access and runbook: https://drive.google.com/novatech/eval-pack
- Attachments included: novatech_map_draft_v1.pdf, testcases_manifest.csv, access_instructions.md

Next actions:
1) Marina: please countersign the MAP via DocuSign by EOD 7/22 so we can open the upload window on 7/16 (we’ve reserved a slot with ops).
2) Novatech: upload manifest + files to the pre-authorized bucket per access_instructions.md. Ben will coordinate the upload window and credentials.
3) Run acceptance tests during 7/18–7/25; share the runbook and metrics in the shared Drive folder.

If you prefer a 30-day retention, note that we will need a short amendment in the MAP and a one-time retention fee; we can include that in the DocuSign flow.

We’ll keep communications tight during the acceptance window; please escalate to me directly if anything blocks sign-off.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
